findings.message: event 'SystemEvents.A' is subscribed (handler 'HA') to a static (process-lived) event source that outlives 'A'; the strong subscription promotes 'A' to the source's lifetime, so it can never be collected — a region escape (leak, no release path)
event 'bus.A' is subscribed (handler 'HB') but never unsubscribed; its source is an injected dependency whose lifetime is unknown, so it may outlive and keep 'A' alive (possible leak)
event 'bus.B' is subscribed (handler 'HC') but never unsubscribed; its source is an injected dependency whose lifetime is unknown, so it may outlive and keep 'B' alive (possible leak)

event 'SystemEvents.B' is subscribed (handler 'HD') to a static (process-lived) event source that outlives 'B'; the strong subscription promotes 'B' to the source's lifetime, so it can never be collected — a region escape (leak, no release path)
